primary_arm_reference.title: ARM Architecture Reference Manual ARMv8, for ARMv8-A architecture profile
primary_arm_reference.rule: FPSP/FPDP1 and2 support VFPv2 andv3 respectively; constants/fixed-point needv3. Divide/sqrt additionally need their own field1. Single/double conversion needs both precisions.

qemu_primary_source.sections: translate-vfp.c trans_VMOV_64_dp and trans_VLDM_VSTM_dp explicitly separate64bit storage from double arithmetic; do_vfp_3op_dp and conversion helpers distinguish precision; VCVT_fix_sp/dp require v3.

independent_execution.scope: Single-only Thumb VFP instruction capability control from actual QEMU CPU fields; no A32-mode or physical Cortex-M4 claim. RAX standalone A32 borrows only the shared instruction/precision boundary, not M-profile privilege/exception semantics.
independent_execution.fixture_correction: v1 exited normally but lacked UART transmission because CMSDK UART CTRL.TXEN was not set; v2 enables TX before markers. Both raw versions retained.
independent_execution.elf_producer: Exact source, LLVM MC and LLD commands retained with raw stdout/stderr in qualification.json.

field_boundary_tests: Independently varied reserved and VFPv2 fields test exact field admission, not the existence of a processor combining all varied fields.
